cards.audioText:
UAL 919, we've just been struck by lightning, and we'll have to go back to the ramp to check our electrics, and make sure there is no damage on the fuselage.
Question: what will the crew do?
cards.audioTextZh:
UAL 919航班，我们刚刚遭遇雷击，需要返回停机坪检查电气系统，并确保机身没有损坏。
问题：机组人员会怎么做？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Make sure the systems are ok
choices: Make sure the systems are ok
Make sure if anyone is struck
Make sure airframe is not electrified
choicesZh: 确认是否有人遭到雷击

cards.audioText:
CES 5152 returned to the airport after taking off from Beijing, because a passenger was found not on board while the luggage was on the airplane.
Question: what happened to CES 5152?
cards.audioTextZh:
CES 5152航班从北京起飞后返回机场，原因是发现有乘客未登机但行李在飞机上。
问题：CES 5152航班发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. One passenger was lost

cards.audioText:
Shortly after the engine lost power, its speed decreased to about 1000 to 1100 RPM. The pilot pushed the throttle forward, but obtained no response from the engine.
Question: what is the reason for no response from the engine?
cards.audioTextZh:
发动机失去动力后不久，其转速降至约1000至1100转/分钟。飞行员向前推油门，但发动机没有反应。
问题：发动机没有反应的原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The engine lost power

cards.audioText:
They said that most passengers of the 737-400 were held up due to a woman getting stuck in the aircraft door while trying to exit the plane!
Question: What had happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
据说，这架737-400的大多数乘客都被耽搁了，原因是一名女子在试图下飞机时被卡在了舱门处！
问题：发生了什么事？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Passengers were jammed on board
choices: The door of the plane was broken
A woman could not get off the plane
A woman was stuck in the seat
choicesZh: 一名女子被卡在座位上

cards.audioText:
2. CES 554, turn right heading 350, R30 route unavailable due military operations, call you back.
Question: Why did the controller ask the pilot to change the heading?
cards.audioTextZh:
2. CES 554，右转航向350，由于军事活动，R30航路不可用，稍后再呼叫你。
问题：管制员为什么要求飞行员改变航向？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Due air force flight

cards.audioText:
CCA 981, we are standing on the stop way, executing emergency evacuation, request emergency services.
Question: What will the crew need?
cards.audioTextZh:
CCA 981，我们停在停止道上，正在实施紧急撤离，请求应急救援服务。
问题：机组需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. all of above

cards.audioText:
BAW 564, stop and hold position. A B737 has taken a wrong turning and is blocking the taxiway.
Question: Why was the pilot instructed to stop?
cards.audioTextZh:
BAW 564，停止并保持当前位置。一架B737转错了弯，正在堵塞滑行道。
问题：为什么飞行员被指示停止？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Because another traffic has taken a wrong turning.
choices: Because the crew has taken a wrong turning.
Because another traffic has taken a wrong turning.
Because BAW 564 has blocked the way of 737.
Because BAW 564 has taken the wrong way.
choicesZh: 因为另一架飞机转错了弯

cards.audioText:
QFA 564, we have got a suspected cholera patient on board. Request necessary services on landing.
Question: What might be needed on landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
QFA 564，我们机上有一名疑似霍乱患者。请求落地时提供必要服务。
问题：落地时可能需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An ambulance

cards.audioText:
Ground, CES 5056, we found some mistakes with takeoff center of gravity and zero fuel center of gravity when we were checking the loading sheet. Would you recheck it and correct the mistakes?
Question: What do you learn from the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
地面，CES 5056，我们检查载重表时发现起飞重心和零燃油重心有一些错误。请你们重新检查并更正这些错误，可以吗？
问题：从这段陈述中你了解到什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Wrong calculation on the loading sheet
choices: Correct calculation on the loading sheet
Wrong calculation on the loading sheet
The ground personnel found the mistakes

cards.audioText:
Each pilot in command of an aircraft is, during flight time, responsible for the safety of the passengers, crewmembers, cargo, and aircraft.
Question: What’s the captain’s responsibility?
cards.audioTextZh:
每名航空器机长在飞行期间都对乘客、机组成员、货物和航空器的安全负责。
问题：机长的职责是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. To ensure the safety
choices: To be in charge of the aircraft
To be responsible for the passengers

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, HDA 305, we cannot extend the nose gear due to a hydraulic problem. Request making a low pass for a visual check. C: HDA 305, make a low pass, not below 45 meters, over the Runway 36.
Question: what is the level for low pass?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，HDA 305，因液压问题无法放下前起落架，请求进行低空通场目视检查。
管制员：HDA 305，可以低空通场，高度不低于45米，通过36号跑道。
问题：低空通场的高度是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. 45m

cards.audioText:
P: CCA 101, we are now 4800 meters, passing WZF, information E received. C: CCA 101, radar contact, descend to 3000 meters, turn right heading 040, radar vectored ILS approach Runway 36R.
Question: What are the controller's instructions on new altitude, flight heading, and runway in use?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：CCA 101，我们现在高度4800米，正通过WZF导航点，已收到E情报。
管制员：CCA 101，雷达已识别，下降至3000米，右转航向040，雷达引导至36右跑道仪表着陆系统进近。
问题：管制员关于新高度、飞行航向和使用跑道的指令是什么？

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141 continue on the inner, at M join the outer, cross Three One Left at K. P: OK, by the inner and M outer and KA, cross Three One Left, BAW 141.
Question: what is the controllers taxiing instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 141，继续沿内侧滑行，在M点切入外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31左跑道。
飞行员：好的，沿内侧滑行，经M外侧和K点，穿越31左跑道，BAW 141。
问题：管制员的滑行指令是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K
choices: K to inner, outer, cross 31L at M
Inner, M to outer, cross 31L at K
M to outer, inner, cross 31L at K
M to inner, outer, cross 31L at K
choicesZh: 经K到内侧和外侧滑行道，在M点穿越31L跑道
沿内侧滑行道，经M到外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道
经M到外侧和内侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道
经M到内侧和外侧滑行道，在K点穿越31L跑道

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CSN 3308, holding short of Runway 36R. CTL: CSN 3308, line up after the landing 747, number two for departure. P: Roger, looking for traffic, traffic in sight. CSN 3308.
Question: What is the pilot doing?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，CSN 3308，在36R跑道外等待。管制员：CSN 3308，在正在着陆的747之后进跑道对正，你是第二个起飞。飞行员：收到，正在寻找相关航空器，已看到相关航空器，CSN 3308。
问题：飞行员正在做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Waiting to get on the runway
choices: Waiting to get on the runway

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 342, Wuhan Radar, for identification, turn left 30 degrees, heading 360. P: Wuhan Radar, UAL 342, we have a transponder on board. Request the transponder code. C: UAL 342, squawk 2234. P: Squawk 2234, UAL 342.
Question: What does the pilot mean by saying he has a transponder on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：UAL 342，武汉雷达，为识别，左转30度，航向360。飞行员：武汉雷达，UAL 342，我们机上有应答机，请求应答机编码。管制员：UAL 342，应答机编码2234。飞行员：应答机编码2234，UAL 342。
问题：飞行员说机上有应答机是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. To get a SSR code
choices: To confirm that the transponder is working
To inform the controller the type of the aircraft
choicesZh: 获取二次监视雷达编码
告知管制员航空器机型
改变二次监视雷达模式

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, BAW 782, we have a fast moving traffic in front us. It looks like a fighter from here. We don't have it on our TCAS, have you observed it? C: We didn't see it on our radar either, probably a fighter without a transponder or not using transponder.
Question: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉管制，BAW 782，我们前方有一个快速移动的目标。从这里看像是一架战斗机。我们的TCAS上没有显示，你们观察到了吗？管制员：我们的雷达上也没有看到，可能是一架未安装应答机或未使用应答机的战斗机。
问题：他们在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Conflicting aircraft

cards.audioText:
P: Control, JAL 785, TCAS descending, we have a fast moving traffic on my TCAS indication. I am following the TCAS RA instructions to avoid the conflicting traffic. C: JAL 785, I just saw it on my radar. It must be a fighter according to its speed. Report TCAS altitude resumed.
Question: What did the aircraft encounter?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：管制，JAL 785，TCAS指令下降。我们的TCAS显示有一个快速移动的目标。我正在按照TCAS的RA指令避让冲突航空器。管制员：JAL 785，我刚在雷达上看到它。根据其速度判断，那一定是一架战斗机。恢复TCAS指令前的高度时报告。
问题：该飞机遇到了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An intruder
choices: An altitude loss on the airborne radar
choicesZh: 机载雷达显示高度丢失

cards.audioText:
C: BAW 141, Wuhan Ground, hold for a while at holding point C. P: We have been holding for ten minutes already. C: BAW 141, there are bird activities on both sides of the upwind. P: Roger. Holding, BAW 141
Question: Why was BAW 141 instructed to hold?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：BAW 141，武汉地面，在C等待点等待一会儿。飞行员：我们已经等了十分钟。管制员：BAW 141，上风区两侧有鸟类活动。飞行员：收到，继续等待，BAW 141。
问题：为什么BAW 141被指示等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Birds over the takeoff path

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan control, CCA 4106, ZF-1D, 3,600m, can I expedite climbing to 6,600m? I am a little behind the schedule. CTL: CCA 4106, negative for the moment due traffic. Climb and maintain 5,400m.
Question: What is the pilot's intention?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉管制，CCA 4106，ZF-1D，高度3600米，我可以加快爬升至6600米吗？我的航班有些晚点。管制员：CCA 4106，由于交通原因，暂时不能。爬升并保持5400米。
问题：飞行员的意图是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. He would like to catch up time
choices: He would like to catch up time
He would climb to 5,400 due the schedule
He cannot climb to 6,600 m due traffic
choicesZh: 他因时刻表原因爬升至5400米
由于交通原因他不能爬升至6600米

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, NWA 303, maintaining 5100 meters. Estimating LKG 11, information F received. C: NWA 303, Wuhan Approach, the latest information is G, please check it. Report passing LKG. P: Wuhan Approach NWA 303, wilco.
Question: What should the pilot do after ATC issues the instructions?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，NWA 303，保持5100米，预计11分到达LKG，已收到F通播。管制员：NWA 303，武汉进近，最新通播为G，请查收。飞越LKG时报告。飞行员：武汉进近，NWA 303，照办。
问题：空中交通管制发布指令后，飞行员应做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Verify the ATIS
choicesZh: 核实自动终端情报服务信息

cards.audioText:
A controller instructed CCA 101 to leave 9500 meters for 8900 meters. He then found his instruction was not correct, and changed the instruction by asking CCA 101 descending to 9200 meters.
Question: Which word can be used to express the controller's meaning?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员指令CCA 101从9500米下降至8900米。随后发现指令有误，更正为下降至9200米。
问题：哪个词可以表达管制员的意图？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. correction

cards.audioText:
P: Good afternoon, sir. Officer: Good afternoon. What can I do for you? P: I am the captain of UAL 303. I would like to check the weather information. When can we depart Officer: The thunderstorm is cleared away, and you can depart as scheduled. P: Thank you.
Question: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：下午好，先生。工作人员：下午好，有什么可以帮您？飞行员：我是UAL 303的机长，想查看天气信息。我们什么时候可以起飞？工作人员：雷暴已经消散，你们可以按计划起飞。飞行员：谢谢。
问题：他们在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Weather information
choices: When the pilot can leave the office
choicesZh: 飞行员何时可以离开办公室

cards.audioText:
P: Sir, would you mind coming in to help us? M: Captain, What is the matter? \ P: It is difficult to use the safety belts and shoulder harness, would you mind checking it? M: The shoulder harness works properly. Eh, safety belts are really to tight, let me fix it for you.
Question: According to the mechanic, which part doesn't work?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：先生，您介意进来帮帮我们吗？机务：机长，出了什么问题？飞行员：安全带和肩带不太好用，您能检查一下吗？机务：肩带工作正常。嗯，安全带确实太紧了，我来帮您调一下。
问题：根据机务人员所说，哪一部分不能正常使用？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Safety belts

cards.audioText:
Dispatcher: How are you, Captain? P: Fine, thank you. I thought you might have made a mistake in my flight plan. DIS: Pardon. P: Our cruising level is 9,800 meters. But this flight plan has been filled out without the letter “W”, which means RVSM qualified. DIS: Oh, sorry, we should have filled-in the “W” in item 10. We will change it now.
Question: What is the meaning of the alphabet “W” mentioned in the exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
签派员：机长，您好。飞行员：很好，谢谢。我想你可能把我的飞行计划填错了。签派员：请再说一遍。飞行员：我们的巡航高度是9800米，但这份飞行计划中没有填写字母“W”，它表示具备RVSM资格。签派员：哦，对不起，我们本应在第10项中填写“W”，现在就修改。
问题：通话中提到的字母“W”表示什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. The aircraft and the operator is RVSM qualified
choices: The aircraft and the operator is RVSM qualified
choicesZh: 航空器及运营人均具备RVSM资格

cards.audioText:
Captain: Look, there is a vehicle ahead, it looks like a follow-me-van. Did you request it from the controller? For the time being, we don't need it and we can handle the situation. FO: No. I guess other aircraft need it. The dense fog today is a big problem for all aircraft.
Question: What does the first speaker imply?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：看，前方有一辆车，看起来像引导车。是你向管制员申请的吗？目前我们不需要它，能够自行处理。副驾驶：没有。我猜是其他飞机需要它。今天的浓雾对所有飞机来说都是个大问题。
问题：第一位说话者暗示了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They can solve the problem by themselves
choices: They do need a follow-me- van
He likes a follow-me van in a dense fog day
He wishes the controller send a follow-me van to them
They can solve the problem by themselves
choicesZh: 他喜欢在浓雾天使用引导车
他希望管制员派引导车来接他们
他们可以自行解决问题

cards.audioText:
Captain: Ladies and gentlemen, we have to return to the gate for more fuel due to the traffic control.. Passenger: We wanna depart immediately Captain: I am qualified in ditching. So, do you want to get gas or get wet?
Question: What is the dispute between the crew and passengers?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：女士们、先生们，由于交通管制，我们必须返回登机口补充燃油。乘客：我们想马上起飞。机长：我具备水上迫降资质。那么，你们是想加油，还是想落水？
问题：机组与乘客争论的是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. To be refueled or depart immediately
choices: To get gas or to get wet
To be refueled or depart immediately
To return or to get wet
To ditch or to get wet

cards.audioText:
Captain: Purser, please tell the passengers the taxi will be very slow as I can barely see anything.. Purser: Ok. Purser: Ladies and gentleman, the Captain just advised he is lost. He has all his maps out and has called the follow-me-van, but it will take a long time to get to the gate. Please be patient.
Question: What does the purser mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
机长：乘务长，请告诉乘客，由于我几乎什么也看不见，滑行会非常缓慢。乘务长：好的。乘务长：女士们、先生们，机长刚通知说他迷路了。他已经把所有地图都拿出来，并呼叫了引导车，但到达登机口还需要很长时间。请耐心等待。
问题：乘务长是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Be patient and wait
choices: The captain figured out the routes with maps
The captain had called for help but in vain
choicesZh: 机长用地图查明了航路
机长曾求助但没有结果

cards.audioText:
My best friend used to work for Thai Airways. He lived there for more than 10 years until he was offered a better job at Air France. Now he must decide whether he should take an even better job with Air China or stay in France. One problem is that he doesn't speak Chinese.
Question: Which statement is correct?
cards.audioTextZh:
我最好的朋友以前在泰国航空工作。他在那里生活了十多年，后来获得法国航空提供的一份更好的工作。现在，他必须决定是接受中国国际航空一份更好的工作，还是留在法国。一个问题是他不会说中文。
问题：以下哪项说法正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. The best job is with Air China.
choices: He has decided to go to Air China.
He's going to leave Air France.
The best job is with Air China.
He has lived in France for 10 years.
choicesZh: 他已决定去中国国际航空
最好的工作在中国国际航空

cards.audioText:
A wingtip vortex is found during takeoff, cruise and landing. When the aircraft flies in ground effect, the ground interferes with the wingtip vortex, which reduces drag. When the aircraft is flying very near the ground, vortex strength is much less; therefore, there is a large reduction in drag.
Question: What's the main topic of the statement?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞机在起飞、巡航和着陆阶段都会产生翼尖涡流。当飞机在地面效应范围内飞行时，地面会干扰翼尖涡流，从而减小阻力。飞机非常接近地面时，涡流强度明显减弱，因此阻力大幅降低。
问题：这段陈述的主题是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Vortex.

cards.audioText:
AFR 145 is currently en route from Paris to London Heathrow. The aircraft is descending to 3000 ft and requesting direct routing TLA. ATC is unable to grant the request due to conflicting traffic at 3000 ft.
Question: Why did Air Traffic Control deny the request of AFR 145?
cards.audioTextZh:
AFR 145目前正在从巴黎飞往伦敦希思罗的航路上。飞机正下降至3000英尺，并请求直飞TLA。由于3000英尺处有冲突航空器，空中交通管制无法批准该请求。
问题：空中交通管制为什么拒绝AFR 145的请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Conflicting Traffic

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 4106, expedite climb to 9800 meters, report HZ. P: Unable to accept 9800 meters, due weight, CCA 4106.
Question: what does the controller mean?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 4106，加速爬升至9800米，过HZ报告。
飞行员：CCA 4106，因重量原因无法接受9800米。
问题：管制员是什么意思？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Issuing a further climb instruction
choices: Complaining about the weight of the flight

cards.audioText:
P: DAL 303, we'll have to go back to the maintenance apron to check our flight controls. We found the rudder pedals are a bit tight. C: DAL 303, Roger, taxi to stand one two. We'll contact maintenance department.
Question: what is the problem?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：达美303，我们需要返回维修停机坪检查飞行操纵系统，发现方向舵踏板有点紧。
管制员：达美303，收到，滑行到12号停机位，我们会联系维修部门。
问题：是什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. The rudder pedals are jammed

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 345, your departure time is 1610. Is that correct? P: Affirm, that is our planned departure. C: I will call you 15 minutes before start up.
Question: when will the pilot contact ATC?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CSN 345，你的起飞时间是16:10，对吗？
飞行员：确认，这是我们计划的起飞时间。
管制员：我会在启动前15分钟呼叫你。
问题：飞行员何时会联系空管？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Fifteen minutes before start-up

cards.audioText:
P: Hong Kong approach, CSN 305, what are the delays like? We’ve been holding for over 50 minutes? C: 305, expect another 10 minutes delay due ground accident.
Question: What is the total waiting time for the crew?

问题：机组总共要等待多长时间？

cards.audioText:

问题：CSN 5402的飞行员将做什么？

choices: After the Airbus on final, line up

cards.audioText:

Question: What happened on board?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，HDA 306，我们刚在机上发现一张纸条，上面说货舱里被安放了炸弹，请求优先着陆和紧急援助。进近：HDA 306，武汉进近，收到，下降至900米，航向050。
问题：机上发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. There is a bomb threat on board
choices: A passenger on board is very sick
There is a bomb threat on board
A note was found in the hold
There is a bomb on board
choicesZh: 机上一名乘客病情严重

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA 981, stop immediately, I say again, stop now. Flames coming from right main gear. P: stopping, 981. CTL: 981, fire engines and ambulance will be available in a few minutes.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制员：CCA 981，立即停止，我再说一遍，马上停止。右主起落架冒出火焰。飞行员：正在停止，981。管制员：981，消防车和救护车将在几分钟内到达。
问题：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Undercarriage fire

cards.audioText:

Question: What is the pilot’s request?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：塔台，SIA 895，我们飞越了外指点标但没有收到信号，正在复飞。在我们再次尝试着陆前，请检查你方的外指点标。管制员：SIA 895，收到，按标准程序。管制员：SIA 895，外指点标工作正常。
问题：飞行员提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Examine the outer marker

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Approach, ACA 226, fire now under control, cancel distress. C: Roger, ACA 226. Break, all stations, distress cancelled.
Question: What are they talking about?
cards.audioTextZh:
飞行员：武汉进近，ACA 226，火势现已得到控制，取消遇险状态。管制员：收到，ACA 226。各台注意，遇险状态取消。
问题：他们在谈论什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Cancellation of distress

cards.audioText:
CTL: CCA 4106, line up after the landing airbus. Call me when ready for departure. P: Traffic in sight, CCA 4106.
Question: What should the pilot do right now?
cards.audioTextZh:

问题：飞行员现在应该做什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Hold his position

cards.audioTextZh: 第二个，看见飞机了。

cards.audioText: Straight-in visual approach, Runway 34.
cards.audioTextZh: 直接目视进近，跑道34号。

cards.audioText: Extend downwind, Number Two, airbus 320 in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 延长三边，第二个，看见空客320了。

cards.audioText: Orbit right. Number Two.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转一圈。第二个。

cards.audioText: Number Two, follow airbus 320 ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: 第二个，跟着前面的空客320。

cards.audioText: Make a short approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 五边不要太长。

cards.audioText: Long final, airfield in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 长五边，看见机场了。

cards.audioText: Continue approach Runway 25.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续进近，跑道25号。

cards.audioText: Runway 27, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道27号，可以落地。

cards.audioText: Short final, request wind check.
cards.audioTextZh: 短五边，请问风向风速。

cards.audioText: Request low pass due unsafe landing gear indication.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于不安全的起落架指示，请求低空通场。

cards.audioText: Low pass approved Runway 27, not below 500 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以低空通场，跑道27，高度不低于500英尺。

cards.audioText: Landing clearance canceled. Continue approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 取消落地许可。继续进近。

cards.audioText: Behind the Boeing737, cleared to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 波音737落地后，可以落地。

cards.audioText: Request low approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求低高度进近。

cards.audioText: Runway not in sight, going around.
cards.audioTextZh: 看不见跑道，复飞了。

cards.audioText: No contact at minimum, going around.
cards.audioTextZh: 看不见地面，复飞了。

cards.audioText: Wind shear, going around.
cards.audioTextZh: 风切变，复飞了。

cards.audioText: Going around, localizer fluctuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 复飞了，航向道波动。

cards.audioText: Follow the standard missed approach procedure, climbing to 3000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 按照标准的复飞程序，上升到3000英尺。

cards.audioText: Take first right. When vacated, contact Ground 118.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 第一个道口右转。脱离跑道后，联系地面118.35。

cards.audioText: After vacated contact Ground 121.6.
cards.audioTextZh: 脱离跑道后，联系地面121.6。

cards.audioText: Taxi to Stand 27 via Taxiway A.
cards.audioTextZh: 经由滑行道A，滑行至27号停机位。

cards.audioText: Taxi to the end of Runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 滑到跑道末端。

cards.audioText: Confirm construction work adjacent to Gate 37.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实37号停机位附近正在施工。

cards.audioText: Confirm centerline taxiway lighting unserviceable.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实中线滑行道灯不工作。

cards.audioText: Confirm PAPI light unserviceable.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实PAPI灯不工作。

cards.audioText: The Runway light is too bright. Request dim it.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道灯太亮。请调暗一些。

cards.audioText: Flock of birds 3 miles final.
cards.audioTextZh: 五边3海里处有鸟群。

cards.audioText: Runway covered with patches of water, braking action medium.
cards.audioTextZh: 大片水覆盖跑道，刹车效应中等。

cards.audioText: Confirm airport rescue and fire facilities category.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实机场救援和防火设备的种类。

cards.audioText: Is the weather improving or deteriorating?
cards.audioTextZh: 天气在好转还是恶化？

cards.audioText: Confirm current RVR less than 400 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实最新RVR小于400米。

cards.audioText: Confirm visibility more than 1000 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实能见度大于1000米。

cards.audioText: Is mid-point RVR available?
cards.audioTextZh: 中间点的RVR可用吗？

cards.audioText: Confirm RVR Runway 27.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实27号跑道的RVR。

cards.audioText: RVR Runway 27 is 600 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 27号跑道的RVR是600米。

cards.audioText: Confirm touchdown RVR greater than 350 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实接地点RVR大于350米。

cards.audioText: Confirm stop-end RVR 150 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实停止端RVR150米。

cards.audioText: Confirm midpoint RVR more than 550 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实中间段RVR大于550米。

cards.audioText: Confirm threshold Runway 27 displaced.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实27号跑道入口内移。

cards.audioText: The runway surface is damp. Braking action good.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道道面潮湿。刹车效应好。

cards.audioText: Confirm the reason for our flight suspension.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实我们航班暂停的原因。

cards.audioText: Confirm our flight has been suspended due bio-hazards at destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实我们航班暂停是由于目的地机场生化物品泄露。

cards.audioText: Confirm the reason for impounding our aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实扣押我们飞机的原因。

cards.audioText: Tow approved via A to remote apron.
cards.audioTextZh: 经滑行道A拖飞机至远机坪。

cards.audioText: Request de-icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求除冰。

cards.audioText: Request frost removal only at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求只在停机位除霜。

cards.audioText: De-icing completed. Request taxi.
cards.audioTextZh: 完成除冰。请求滑行。

cards.audioText: Request start engine at the gate.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求在停机位开车。

cards.audioText: Request time check.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求校时。

cards.audioText: Request backtrack.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求掉头。

cards.audioText: Unable BK-1A Departure due performance. Request BK-1B.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于性能原因，不能BK-1A号离场。请求BK-1B（离场）。

cards.audioText: Request departure instruction.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求离场指令。

cards.audioText: When airborne, track extended center-line, cleared for takeoff,Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 离地后，保持跑道中心的延长线，跑道18，可以起飞。

cards.audioText: Contact Arrival 118.050.
Request remote apron for maintenance purpose.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于维护原因请求远机坪停机。

cards.audioText: Continue present heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续当前航向。

cards.audioText: Resume own navigation to BK.
cards.audioTextZh: 恢复自主领航至BK。

cards.audioText: Confirm identification lost.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实识别丢失。

cards.audioText: Identified, position 50 miles east of BK.
cards.audioTextZh: 已识别，位置BK以东50海里。

cards.audioText: 30 miles from touchdown, contact Approach 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 离接地点30海里，联系进近118.1。

cards.audioText: Three sixty turn left.
cards.audioTextZh: 左转360度

cards.audioText: Orbit left for delay.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于延误左转一圈。

cards.audioText: Looking out.
cards.audioTextZh: 正在寻找。

cards.audioText: Traffic in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 看见了。

cards.audioText: Negative contact due IMC.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于仪表气象条件，看不见。

cards.audioText: Traffic passed and clear.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机已通过无影响。

cards.audioText: Squawk 7563.
Reset squawk 5101.
cards.audioTextZh: 重置应答机5101。

cards.audioText: Squawk ident.
cards.audioTextZh: 应答机识别。

cards.audioText: Squawk standby.
cards.audioTextZh: 应答机待命（待机）模式。

cards.audioText: Squawk Charlie and code 5120.
cards.audioTextZh: 应答机C模式，编码5120。

cards.audioText: Stopping squawk Charlie.
cards.audioTextZh: 关掉应答机C模式。

cards.audioText: Affirm squawk 7500.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以设置应答机7500。

cards.audioText: Altimeter 1003 8000ft.
cards.audioTextZh: 高度表1003，高度8000英尺。

cards.audioText: Negative squawk ident due transponder failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于应答机失效，无法识别应答机。

cards.audioText: Turn right heading 340.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向340。

cards.audioText: Turn right 20 degrees.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转20度。

cards.audioText: Leave BK heading 190.
cards.audioTextZh: 离开BK，航向190。

cards.audioText: Fly heading 285.
cards.audioTextZh: 航向飞285。

cards.audioText: Stop turn heading 070.
cards.audioTextZh: 停止转弯，航向070。

cards.audioText: Request heading 180 due weather.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于天气，请求航向180。

cards.audioText: Confirm danger area 113 active.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实危险区域113有活动。

cards.audioText: 50 miles right of track approved, when able, proceed direct TB.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以右偏离航迹50海里，如可能，直飞TB。

cards.audioText: Indicated speed 270 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 指示空速270节。

cards.audioText: Maintain 300 knots or less.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持速度300节或更小。

cards.audioText: Maintain 180 knots until 8 miles from touchdown.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持180节直到离接地点8海里。

cards.audioText: Maintain Mach decimal 82, transition speed 310 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持马赫数点82，转换速度310节。

cards.audioText: Maintain speed 280 knots or greater for separation.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于间隔，保持速度280节或更大。

cards.audioText: Cross CK at 35 or later.
cards.audioTextZh: 穿越CK台35分或之后。

cards.audioText: Cross DG at 24 or earlier.
cards.audioTextZh: 24分或稍早时间穿越DG。

cards.audioText: Do not exceed 280 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 速度不要超过280节。

cards.audioText: Reduce speed to 240 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 减速到240节。

cards.audioText: Increase speed to 300 knots or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: 增速到300节或更大。

cards.audioText: Increase speed by 10 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 速度增加10节。

cards.audioText: Resume normal speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 恢复正常速度。

cards.audioText: No speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 没有速度限制。

cards.audioText: Request speed 200 knots due configuration.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于构型，请求速度200节。

cards.audioText: Request speed 250 knots due turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于颠簸，请求速度250节。

cards.audioText: Omit position reports until LN.
cards.audioTextZh: LN前省略位置报。

cards.audioText: Next report at IP.
cards.audioTextZh: 下一报告点IP。

cards.audioText: Report required only at boundary.
cards.audioTextZh: 只要求在交接点报告。

cards.audioText: Traffic indication at our 1 o’clock, 4 miles, same altitude,converging.
cards.audioTextZh: 活动飞机显示在1点钟方位，4海里，同高度，正在汇聚。

cards.audioText: Request vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求引导。

cards.audioText: Unable to receive transmission on that frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 那个频率收不到发报。

cards.audioText: Request 15 miles final.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求五边15海里。

cards.audioText: Maintain 3000 feet until glide path interception.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持3000英尺，直到截获下滑道。

cards.audioText: NOTAM says glide slope for Runway15 is unserviceable,confirm.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行员通告表明15号跑道下滑道故障，证实。

cards.audioText: Confirm ILS frequency for Runway 17L.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实17左跑道的盲降频率。

cards.audioText: In case of going around, turn left heading 210.
cards.audioTextZh: 如复飞，左转航向210。

cards.audioText: Advise transponder capability.
cards.audioTextZh: 请告知应答机可用模式。

cards.audioText: Transponder Charlie.
cards.audioTextZh: 应答机C模式。

cards.audioText: Transponder unserviceable.
cards.audioTextZh: 应答机故障。

cards.audioText: ADS-B transmitter 1090 (ten-ninety) data link.
cards.audioTextZh: ADS-B发射机1090数据链。

cards.audioText: ADS-B receiver 1090 (ten-ninety) data link.
cards.audioTextZh: ADS-B接收机1090数据链。

cards.audioText: Negative ADS-B.
cards.audioTextZh: 没有ADS-B。

cards.audioText: Re-enter ADS-B aircraft identification.
cards.audioTextZh: 重新输入ADS-B飞机识别码。

cards.audioText: Stop ADS-B transmission.
cards.audioTextZh: 停止ADS-B发射。

cards.audioText: Stop squawk transmit ADS-B only.
cards.audioTextZh: 停止应答机只发报ADS-B。

cards.audioText: Fly no further west of your current position.
cards.audioTextZh: 当前位置不要再往西飞了。

cards.audioText: Unable identify the waypoint, request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能识别此航路点，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: Right heading 120, my own terrain clearance.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向120，自行避让地形。

cards.audioText: Heading 120, correction, 140.
cards.audioTextZh: 航向120，更正一下，140。

cards.audioText: Confirm we are still above your minimum vectoring altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实我们仍然高于你们的最低引导高度。

cards.audioText: Right heading 040 until passing FL70 then direct to BK.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向040直到通过高度层70，然后直飞BK。

cards.audioText: Direct to JO, descend to FL50.
cards.audioTextZh: 直飞JO，下降到高度层50。

cards.audioText: Passing FL70.
cards.audioTextZh: 通过高度层70。

cards.audioText: Descending to 4000 feet QNH1005, expect ILS approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到4000英尺，修正海压1005，预计盲降进近，跑道24号。

cards.audioText: Request straight-in ILS approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求直接盲降进近，跑道24号。

cards.audioText: Cleared straight-in ILS approach Runway 24, descend to 3000 feet, QNH1011.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以直接盲降进近，跑道24号，下降到3000英尺，修正海压1011。

cards.audioText: Airfield in sight, request visual approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 看见机场了，请求目视进近。

cards.audioText: When established on the localizer, descend on the glide path.
cards.audioTextZh: 建立好航向道后，沿下滑航径下降。

cards.audioText: Established on the localizer.
cards.audioTextZh: 已经建立好航向道。

cards.audioText: Fully established Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 完全建立了，跑道24号。

cards.audioText: Cleared VOR-DME approach Runway 24, descending to 3000 feet QNH1007.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以VOR-DME进近，跑道24号，下降到3000英尺，修正海压1007。

cards.audioText: Runway in sight.
cards.audioTextZh: 看见跑道了。

cards.audioText: Number One, contact Tower 118.7.
cards.audioTextZh: 第一个，联系塔台118.7。

cards.audioText: Passing outer marker.
cards.audioTextZh: 过外指点标了。

cards.audioText: Report MQR outbound.
cards.audioTextZh: MQR背台报告。

cards.audioText: Procedure turn completed, localizer established.
cards.audioTextZh: 完成程序转弯，并建立好航向道。

cards.audioText: Request visual approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求目视进近。

cards.audioText: Cleared visual approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以目视进近，跑道24号。

cards.audioText: Request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求等待指令。

cards.audioText: Request holding procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求等待程序。

cards.audioText: Overhead YV, maintaining 3000 feet, entering hold.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞越YV，保持3000英尺，进入等待。

cards.audioText: Leaving BKM VOR heading 110.
cards.audioTextZh: 离开BKMVOR台，航向110。

cards.audioText: Leaving FL60, descending to 2500 feet, QNH1008.
cards.audioTextZh: 离开高度层60，下降到2500英尺，修正海压1008。

cards.audioText: Position 10 miles north east of LN.
cards.audioTextZh: 位置在LN东北方向，10海里。

cards.audioText: Turn right heading180 for base leg.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向180加入四边。

cards.audioText: No ATC speed restrictions. Contact Tower 118.9.
cards.audioTextZh: ATC没有速度限制。联系塔台118.9。

cards.audioText: Three sixty turn left for delay.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于延误，左转360度。

cards.audioText: Continue present heading, expect through the localizer for spacing.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续当前航向，由于间隔，预计穿越航向道。

cards.audioText: Surveillance radar approach Runway 27, maintaining 2200 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 监视雷达进近，跑道27号，保持2200英尺。

cards.audioText: QNH1003, threshold elevation 196 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 修正海压1003，入口处标高196英尺。

cards.audioText: Precision radar approach Runway 27 heading 260, descending to 2500 feet, QNH1014.
cards.audioTextZh: 精密雷达进近，跑道27号，航向260，下降到2500英尺，修正海压1014。

cards.audioText: Cleared to JEMMY via BK 1A Arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由BK-1A标准仪表进场去往JEMMY。

cards.audioText: Descend to reach 5000 feet by BK.
cards.audioTextZh: BK点前下降高度到5000英尺。

cards.audioText: When ready, descend to FL200. Report leaving FL300.
cards.audioTextZh: 准备好时，下降到高度层200。离开高度300报告。

cards.audioText: Descend immediately FL250.
cards.audioTextZh: 立即下降到高度250。

cards.audioText: Descend to altitude 12000 feet QNH 1000.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到12000英尺，修正海压1000。

cards.audioText: Descend to height 2000 feet QFE 997 hectopascals.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到场高2000英尺，场压997百帕。

cards.audioText: Descend to 8000 feet at 1000 feet per minute or greater.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到8000英尺，下降率保持或大于1000英尺/分钟。

cards.audioText: Maintain own separation and VMC, descend to FL50.
cards.audioTextZh: 正保持自己的间隔和目视气象条件，正下降到高度层50。

cards.audioText: Increasing rate of climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 增加上升率。

cards.audioText: Unable expedite climb due weight.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于重量，不能加速上升。

cards.audioText: Climb to 6000 feet, follow KODAP 01 Departure.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升到6000英尺，按照KODAP-01号标准仪表离场。

cards.audioText: Passing altitude 2300 feet, climbing to FL80.
cards.audioTextZh: 过高度2300英尺，上升到高度层80。

cards.audioText: Climb to FL210, level restrictions of KODAP 01 Departure canceled.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升到高度210，取消KODAP-01号标准仪表离场的高度限制。

cards.audioText: Climb to FL 210, cross AU at FL100 or below.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升到高度210，飞越AU时不高于高度层100。

cards.audioText: Climb to FL290, level at time 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 爬升到高度290，55分改平。

cards.audioText: Unable FL390 by boundary, request FL330.
cards.audioTextZh: 交接点之前不能到达高度层390，请求高度层330。

cards.audioText: Descend to FL100, cross YU FL150 or above.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到高度层100，飞跃YU时不低于高度层150。

cards.audioText: After passing North Cross, descend to FL150.
cards.audioTextZh: 过了NorthCross，下降到高度150。

cards.audioText: We are far above profile. Request holding.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们太高了，请求等待。

cards.audioText: Stop descent at 5000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 5000英尺停止下降。

cards.audioText: Expedite descent until passing FL80.
cards.audioTextZh: 加速下降通过高度层80。

cards.audioText: Expect descent after AK.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计过AK后下降。

cards.audioText: Continue approach Runway 36R, maintain visual separation with preceding traffic.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续进近，跑道36右，与前机保持目视间隔。

cards.audioText: Contact Control 80 miles after BK.
cards.audioTextZh: 过BK80海里处联系区调。

cards.audioText: Request change to London Control.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求换到伦敦管制频率。

cards.audioText: Monitor Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: 监听塔台频率118.1。

cards.audioText: Remain this frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 本频率长守。

cards.audioText: We can see the approach lights at 200 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 200英尺我们能看到进近灯。

cards.audioText: Cleared VOR approach Runway 36, followed by circling to Runway 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以VOR进近，跑道36号，按照航图目视盘旋，18号落地。

cards.audioText: Expect commencing approach at time 50.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计开始进近时间50分。

cards.audioText: Unable circling approach due company policy. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于公司政策，不能盘旋进近。请求改航。

cards.audioText: Request RNAV approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求RNAV进近。

cards.audioText: RNAV approach not available due FMS database. Request VOR approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于FMS数据库原因，RNAV不可用。请求VOR进近。

cards.audioText: Cleared for LDA approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以航向道偏离进近，跑道24号。

cards.audioText: Unable RNAV due equipment, request conventional arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于设备，不能RNAV进近，请求常规进场。

cards.audioText: Unable RNAV, loss of RAIM, request NDB approach
cards.audioTextZh: 由于RAIM丢失，不能RNAV进近，请求NDB进近。

cards.audioText: GPS primary lost, going around.
cards.audioTextZh: 失去GPS主用，复飞了。

cards.audioText: RAIM alert, going around.
cards.audioTextZh: RAIM警告，复飞了。

cards.audioText: Negative RNAV.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能RNAV进近。

cards.audioText: Proceed to AK, hold as published, expect approach clearance at 30.
cards.audioTextZh: 直飞AK，按公布许可等待，预计进近许可30分。

cards.audioText: Request hold for weather improvement, visibility below company minima.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求等待天气好转，能见度低于公司最低值。

cards.audioText: Holding northwest of W VOR FL120, what is the delay for approach?
cards.audioTextZh: WVOR台西北等待，高度120，请问进近的延误情况。

cards.audioText: Request to extend the holding pattern for accomplishing the checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求延长等待以完成检查单。

cards.audioText: Request extended holding to burn fuel to reduce the weight.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求延长等待以便消耗油减少重量。

cards.audioText: Cleared for CAT II ILS approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 准许Ⅱ类盲降进近，跑道24号。

cards.audioText: Join right hand downwind, visual approach Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 加入右三边，目视进近，跑道24号。

cards.audioText: Continue approach, prepare for possible go around.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续进近，做好可能复飞的准备。

cards.audioText: Disregard. We made the wrong transmission.
cards.audioTextZh: 指令作废。我们发错报了。

cards.audioText: Roger, request continue approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 明白，请求继续进近。

cards.audioText: Stand by. We are carrying out procedures.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍等。我们正在执行程序。

cards.audioText: Wilco, words twice.
cards.audioTextZh: 照办，每字发两遍。

cards.audioText: Maintaining FL350, expect descent after BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持高度350，预计过BKMVOR台后下降。

cards.audioText: Continue climb to FL 290, cross BKM VOR not above FL 230.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续上升到高度290，飞越BKMVOR台不高于高度230。

cards.audioText: Negative, unable cross BKM VOR at or above FL230 due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，由于性能不能在飞越BKMVOR台时高于高度230。

cards.audioText: Maintaining FL310 until advised.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持高度310，等通知。

cards.audioText: Descend to FL170, cross BKM VOR at or above FL210.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到高度170，飞越BKMVOR台时高于高度210。

cards.audioText: Affirm, cross BKM VOR at or above FL190
cards.audioTextZh: 同意，飞越BKMVOR台时高于高度190。

cards.audioText: Negative, unable to cross BKM VOR below FL170.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，飞越BKMVOR台时不能低于高度170。

cards.audioText: Affirm, cross BKM VOR at or before 55
cards.audioTextZh: 可以，在55分或之前飞越BKMVOR台。

cards.audioText: Negative, unable to cross BKM VOR at 43 or later.
cards.audioTextZh: 不行，不能在43分或之后飞越BKMVOR台。

cards.audioText: Request lose time en route due landing delay at destination airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于目的地机场延误请求航路上消耗时间。

cards.audioText: Request lose time en route to finish the checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求航路上消耗时间以完成检查单。

cards.audioText: Request parallel offset from current track due weather ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于前方天气，请求平行偏离当前航迹。

cards.audioText: Request parallel offset from current airway for 30 minutes due icing condition.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于结冰条件，申请在当前航路上平行偏置飞行30分钟。

cards.audioText: Proceed offset 10 miles right of track until abeam BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 右偏航迹10海里直到正切BKMVOR台。

cards.audioText: Cleared offset 25 miles left of track for 30 minutes.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以左偏离航迹25海里飞30分钟。

cards.audioText: Offset canceled, turn right to rejoin the A1 before BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 偏置取消，在到达BKMVOR台前，右转重新加入A1。

cards.audioText: Clear of weather, request to resume flight route.
cards.audioTextZh: 已绕飞天气，请求回到航路。

cards.audioText: Estimating crossing LV NDB 1123.
cards.audioTextZh: 预计1123飞越LVNDB台。

cards.audioText: BKM 47, FL170 descending to FL120, abeam NLD VOR at 55.
cards.audioTextZh: BKM47分，高度170，下降到高度层120，55分正切NLDVOR台。

cards.audioText: Report 25 miles from BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 距离BKMVOR台25海里报告。

cards.audioText: Report 34 miles from Top of Descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 距离下降顶点34海里报告。

cards.audioText: Report crossing 270 radial BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 过BKMVOR台270度径向线报告。

cards.audioText: Report 28 miles DME 210 radial BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: BKMVOR台210度径向线28海里时报告。

cards.audioText: Climb to FL220, report passing FL170.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升高度220，通过高度170报告。

cards.audioText: Descending immediately to FL190.
cards.audioTextZh: 立刻下降到高度190。

cards.audioText: Leaving FL220 for FL190.
cards.audioTextZh: 离开高度220，下降到高度190。

cards.audioText: Remain outside controlled airspace, expect joining clearance at time 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持在管制空域外，预计在55进入。

cards.audioText: Request to leave controlled airspace by descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求通过下降离开管制空域。

cards.audioText: Request to leave controlled airspace by climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求通过爬升离开管制空域。

cards.audioText: Descending to 5000 feet QNH 1014, report passing 7000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到5000英尺，修正海压1014，通过7000英尺报告。

cards.audioText: Request VMC descent to FL60.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求目视气象条件下降到高度层60。

cards.audioText: Request to join airway A1 at DAPRO.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求在DAPRO加入A1航路。

cards.audioText: Remain outside controlled airspace, expect further clearance at 55.
cards.audioTextZh: 保持在管制空域外，预计55分有进一步许可。

cards.audioText: If FL240 not available, we accept FL220.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果高度240不可用，我们接受高度220。

cards.audioText: Confirm we are under radar control.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实我们在雷达管制区。

cards.audioText: Confirm radar service is terminated.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实雷达服务终止。

cards.audioText: Confirm radar control is resumed.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实雷达管制恢复。

cards.audioText: Affirm RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以RVSM。

cards.audioText: Negative RVSM due equipment downgraded.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于设备降级，RVSM不行。

cards.audioText: Request clearance into RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求进入RVSM空域的许可。

cards.audioText: Unable RVSM due turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于颠簸，不能RVSM。

cards.audioText: Ready to resume RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 准备恢复RVSM。

cards.audioText: At 144E(east) squawk 2000.
cards.audioTextZh: 东经144度时，应答机换2000。

cards.audioText: CPDLC connected.
cards.audioTextZh: CPDLC已连接。

cards.audioText: Continue CPDLC make position report via CPDLC.
cards.audioTextZh: 继续CPDLC，由CPDLC做位置报。

cards.audioText: SELCAL CODE EFFG, request SELCAL check.
cards.audioTextZh: 选择呼叫代码EFFG，请求选呼检查。

cards.audioText: CPDLC unserviceable, request to revert to voice communication.
cards.audioTextZh: CPDLC不工作。请求恢复到话音通信。

cards.audioText: The air conditioning system has malfunctioned.
cards.audioTextZh: 空调系统已故障。

cards.audioText: Many passengers are suffering from smoke inhalation. Request medical assistance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 许多旅客遭受烟尘吸入。请求到达时医疗救助。

cards.audioText: Our pressurization system has malfunctioned.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的增压系统故障。

cards.audioText: We have difficulty in controlling the cabin pressure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们控制座舱增压有难度。

cards.audioText: We have a cabin altitude problem.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们座舱高度有问题。

cards.audioText: Our cabin rate of climb has red-lined. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们座舱上升率已达到红线。请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: We have a slow cabin decompression. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们座舱慢释压，请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: We are now depressurized and will fly a more shallow descent profile.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们现在释压飞行，需要更平缓的下降剖面。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with the avionics ventilation system.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的电子通风系统有问题。

cards.audioText: The avionics ventilation is unserviceable. Request diversion to the closest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 电子舱通风故障。请求备降到就近合适机场。

cards.audioText: We have severe vibration coming from the avionics ventilation fan.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的电子通风风扇严重抖振。

cards.audioText: There are unusual noises coming from the avionics bay.
cards.audioTextZh: 电子设备舱有异常噪音。

cards.audioText: Our FMS has malfunctioned. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的飞行管理系统故障了，请求雷达引导。

cards.audioText: Request further climb due wind-shear.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于风切变，申请进一步爬升。

cards.audioText: Unable to maintain altitude, request leaving RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能保持高度，申请离开RVSM空域。

cards.audioText: We cannot make RNP approach due equipment.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于设备，我们不再符合RNP进近。

cards.audioText: Our navigation accuracy is low. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的导航精度低。请求上升到最低安全高度。

cards.audioText: The flight path is unstable. Going around.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞行轨迹不稳定。复飞了。

cards.audioText: We made a missed approach due to unstable ILS signals.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于盲降信号不稳定，我们执行了复飞。

cards.audioText: We have lost our flight plan after a flight management computer reset.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复位了飞行管理计算机后丢失了飞行计划。

cards.audioText: We do not meet GPS approach requirement due to flight crew qualifications.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于机组资格，我们不符合GPS进近要求。

cards.audioText: Our Airline policy does not allow us to perform CAT IIIC approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们公司政策不允许我们执行IIIC类进近。

cards.audioText: Our operations manual forbids this procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的运行手册禁止该程序。

cards.audioText: Our Aviation Authority does not permit this procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们航空当局不允许该程序。

cards.audioText: We are unable to conform to the noise abatement procedure due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于性能，我们不遵守降噪程序。

cards.audioText: All stations, transmitting blind due to receiver failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 各台注意，由于接收机失效，正在盲发。

cards.audioText: Our SELCAL has malfunctioned. We will continue monitoring your frequency.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的选择呼叫失效了，我们会继续监听频率。

cards.audioText: We are receiving an ELT signal on 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在121.5里听到一个紧急定位发射机信号。

cards.audioText: We are picking up a broadcast signal on 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 有人在121.5里发射信号。

cards.audioText: Our satellite phone is unserviceable. We are unable to call company operations.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的卫星电话今天不工作，我们联系不上公司签派。

cards.audioText: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request re-release the flight plan by voice.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据链故障了，申请口头式的二次放行飞行计划。

cards.audioText: Our data-link has malfunctioned. Request ATC clearance by voice.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的数据链故障了，申请口头式的ATC放行许可。

cards.audioText: My apologies, I wasn’t aware the boom mike was transmitting.
cards.audioTextZh: 不好意思，我没发觉手持话筒在发射。

cards.audioText: Sorry for blocking the frequency due microphone jammed.
cards.audioTextZh: 抱歉由于麦克风卡阻堵塞了通信频率。

cards.audioText: We have an electrical failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个电气故障。

cards.audioText: Request diversion to the nearest suitable airport due AC BUS failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一个交流汇流条故障了，申请备降到最近合适机场。

cards.audioText: We are not supplying power to our DC BUS. Request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不再为直流汇流条供电，申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with the aircraft battery. Request priority landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞机电瓶有问题。申请优先落地。

cards.audioText: We have had a bird strike. Our windshield has cracked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遭遇鸟击，风挡出现裂痕。

cards.audioText: The APU is still on fire. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: APU火还在燃烧，我们现在紧急撤离，申请紧急服务。

cards.audioText: Request descent to 10000 feet to ventilate the aircraft due smoke.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于烟雾，请求下降到10000 英尺使飞机得到通风。

cards.audioText: We are having flight control problems.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有飞行操纵问题。

cards.audioText: We cannot fully extend the flaps. Request the longest runway for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能完全放出襟翼，申请最长的跑道落地。

cards.audioText: Some of our fuel pumps have low pressure. Request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些燃油泵低压。请求下降。

cards.audioText: We are leaking fuel slowly. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有慢速漏油。申请改航。

cards.audioText: Request climb for dumping fuel and vectors to the fuel dump zone.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请上升高度放油，申请雷达引导到放油区域。

cards.audioText: Our left engine failed due to fuel starvation.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于没有燃油供给，我们的左发失效。

cards.audioText: We suspect there is contamination in our fuel tanks.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们怀疑油箱里的燃油被污染了。

cards.audioText: One of our hydraulic systems has exceeded temperature limits.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的一个液压系统超温。

cards.audioText: We have shut down one of the hydraulic systems.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经关掉了一个液压系统。

cards.audioText: The backup hydraulic system is operational but we still want to divert.
cards.audioTextZh: 备用液压系统在工作，但我们仍然要备降。

cards.audioText: Two of our hydraulic systems have failed. Request immediate diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有两个液压系统失效，申请立即备降。

cards.audioText: I had to abort takeoff because I didn’t receive any airspeed indication.
cards.audioTextZh: 我必须中断起飞，因为我没有看到任何空速指示。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to navigation accuracy downgrade.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为导航精度降低。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to FMS position error.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为飞行管理计算机误差。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to GPS error.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为GPS误差。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to lateral deviation exceedance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为横向偏离超出限制。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to CDU failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为CDU故障。

cards.audioText: We made the go around because we exceeded the vertical deviation limit.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为我们超出了纵向偏离限制。

cards.audioText: We no longer have altitude warning. Request leaving RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不再具备高度偏离的警告，申请离开RVSM空域。

cards.audioText: Our landing capability has degraded. Request terminate our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的着陆能力（类别）降级。申请终止进近。

cards.audioText: We performed the go-around because we had a ground proximity warning.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为我们出现了近地警告。

cards.audioText: Unable, TCAS RA.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能，TCASRA。

cards.audioText: We are clear of conflict. Request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们解除冲突了。请求进一步指令。

cards.audioText: Our engine parameters are unstable. Request stop climb at FL220.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的发动机参数不稳定。申请在高度220时停止爬升。

cards.audioText: We are reading high engine vibration. Request to delay takeoff.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的发动机读数有较高的抖振。请求延迟起飞。

cards.audioText: Cabin altitude is increasing abnormally. Request to level off.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱高度显示增加异常。请求改平飞。

cards.audioText: Our instruments indicate excessive high cabin altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的仪表显示客舱高度过高。

cards.audioText: Our instrument indicates abnormal cabin pressure differential.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仪表显示不正常的客舱压差。

cards.audioText: Cockpit oxygen cylinder pressure is low. Request to return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱氧气瓶显示低压力，申请返场着陆。

cards.audioText: We cannot extend the left landing gear. Request foaming the runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能放出左起落架。申请在跑道上喷洒泡沫。

cards.audioText: Request diversion to a nearby airport with foaming capability.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请备降到附近一个能够喷洒防火泡沫的机场。

cards.audioText: I think we blew a nose wheel tyre. Request holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我认为我们的前轮爆胎了。申请原地等待。

cards.audioText: We no longer have airspeed and altitude on our primary displays.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的主显示器上不再有空速和高度显示了。

cards.audioText: We have errors with our navigation. Request radar monitoring.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的导航有误差。申请雷达监控。

cards.audioText: We made the go around because the GPWS warning was triggered.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为触发了近地警告。

cards.audioText: Our ADS-B transmitter appears to be malfunctioning. Terminating further ADS-B transmissions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的ADS-B发报机似乎故障了。终止ADS-B发报。

cards.audioText: ADS-B equipment degradation, will advise when able to resume operations.
cards.audioTextZh: ADS-B设备降级，当恢复使用时将告知。

cards.audioText: GPS unreliable, terminating ADS-B transmissions.
cards.audioTextZh: GPS不可靠，终止ADS-B发报。

cards.audioText: Our ADS-B has malfunctioned. Is there any weather advisory at our destination?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的ADS-B发报机已故障。有目的地机场的气象报吗？

cards.audioText: We made an overshoot because our ADS-B indicated a possible runway incursion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为我们的ADS-B显示可能有跑道入侵。

cards.audioText: Our airspeed is unreliable. Request radar vectors for long final.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速指示不可靠，请求雷达引导到长五边。

cards.audioText: We made the go-around because the radio altimeter triggered flare mode.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞的原因是因为无线电高度表诱发了拉平方式。

cards.audioText: Many passengers have suffered from smoke inhalation. Request medical services.
cards.audioTextZh: 许多乘客已经遭受了烟雾吸入。申请医疗服务。

cards.audioText: We are expediting descent to enable a windmill startup. Request further descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在加速下降，为了能够风转启动发动机。申请进一步下降。

cards.audioText: CPDLC has malfunctioned. We are reverting to voice communication.
cards.audioTextZh: CPDLC失效。我们正在恢复语音通信。

cards.audioText: CPDLC terminated due to failure, reverting to voice communication.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于故障终止CPDLC，恢复语音通信。

cards.audioText: We are at bay15. We have an APU fire. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在15号停机位。我们有APU火警。申请灭火服务。

cards.audioText: The windshield is cracked on the outside. Request descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 风挡在外层裂了。请求下降。

cards.audioText: We aborted takeoff due loss of engine oil pressure.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于发动机失去了滑油压力，我们中断起飞了。

cards.audioText: We have an engine oil leak. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有发动机滑油泄漏。申请备降。

cards.audioText: Engine Number One has a temperature problem. Request holding to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 一号发动机有温度问题。申请等待来执行检查单。

cards.audioText: We heard an explosion from the cabin. Request to stop climb.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们听到客舱有爆炸声。申请停止上升。

cards.audioText: We are encountering moderate icing. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遇到了中度结冰。请求立即下降。

cards.audioText: We are on emergency descent due severe icing.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于严重结冰，我们紧急下降了。

cards.audioText: Rime ice was reported by previous aircraft during approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 进近中前机报告有雾凇。

cards.audioText: We have a “Wind-shear Ahead” warning. Request to delay our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们出现了“前方风切变”警告。请求延迟进近。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to wind-shear warning.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞的原因是有风切变警告。

cards.audioText: We won’t have to deviate if you allow us to climb to FL430.
cards.audioTextZh: 如允许我们上升到高度430，我们就不用偏离。

cards.audioText: We have encountered severe clear air turbulence. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已遇到严重晴空颠簸。申请立即下降。

cards.audioText: Request a general heading of 050 due to multiple cells ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于前方多个单体雷雨区，申请大概050的航向。

cards.audioText: Roger heavy rain. Request to terminate our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 明白，大雨。申请终止进近。

cards.audioText: Request immediate one eighty turn to the right due volcanic ash.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于火山灰，申请立即180度右转。

cards.audioText: There are red lights ahead of us. Confirm taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们前方有红色灯。证实滑行指令。

cards.audioText: There is an obstruction ahead. Confirm taxi instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方有障碍物。证实滑行指令。

cards.audioText: We have a suspicious bag on board. Request bomb squad.
cards.audioTextZh: 机上有可疑的包。请求拆弹小组。

cards.audioText: The passengers are evacuating. The bomb is still on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 旅客正在撤离。炸弹还在机上。

cards.audioText: Request a remote apron for parking our aircraft due bomb on board.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于机上有炸弹，请求远机坪停机。

cards.audioText: Request a large airspace to maneuver due flight control problems.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于飞行操纵的问题，请求较大空域做机动。

cards.audioText: Unable visual approach due company policy. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 公司政策原因不能目视进近。申请雷达引导。

cards.audioText: Unable circling approach due company policy. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 公司政策原因不能盘旋进近。申请备降。

cards.audioText: Are we being vectored too close to the parallel aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh: 有架飞机在平行飞行，我们是不是被雷达引导得太近了？

cards.audioText: Is the preceding aircraft crossing our altitude?
cards.audioTextZh: 前机正在穿越我们的高度吗？

cards.audioText: I see wildfire at my 10 o’clock, about 8 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: 我在我10点钟方位，约8海里的地方看到了野火。

cards.audioText: Request offset 10 miles left to avoid the reported strong downdraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求左偏离10海里避开已报告的强下沉气流。

cards.audioText: Request immediate one-eighty turn to the right due to possible hail ahead.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于前方可能有冰雹，申请立即右转180。

cards.audioText: Some of the hijackers are carrying sharp protruding weapons.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些劫机犯拿着锋利的、尖锐的武器。

cards.audioText: Terrorists started to injure passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 恐怖分子开始伤害旅客了。

cards.audioText: Terrorists are threatening to start killing passengers and the crew.
cards.audioTextZh: 恐怖分子们威胁他们将要杀死旅客和机组了。

cards.audioText: A suspicious suitcase was found during the cabin inspection.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱检查中发现了可疑手提箱。

cards.audioText: The air marshal is searching the aircraft interior for any suspicious articles.
cards.audioTextZh: 空中保安正在搜查飞机里面的任何可疑物品。

cards.audioText: What do the bomb-disposal experts suggest we do?
cards.audioTextZh: 拆弹专家们建议我们做什么？

cards.audioText: The cabin crew reports a passenger is behaving strangely.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱机组报告一名旅客行为怪异。

cards.audioText: We have navigation map drift. Request climb to MEA.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有导航地图漂移。申请上升到最低航路高度。

cards.audioText: The cabin crew have used up all the portable extinguishers. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 客舱机组已用完了手提式灭火器，申请备降。

cards.audioText: We almost had a mid-air collision with another aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们差点与另一架飞机空中相撞。

cards.audioText: The conflicting traffic is military. Request avoiding action.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机是军用机。申请避让措施。

cards.audioText: Does the flight path of the unknown aircraft converge with ours?
cards.audioTextZh: 不明飞机的飞行路线和我们会聚吗？

cards.audioText: The conflicting traffic is gray, possibly a military aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机是灰色的，可能是军用机。

cards.audioText: We have traffic indication at 2 o’clock, 300 feet above our level.
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机显示在2点钟方位，高于我们300英尺。

cards.audioText: We have a possible traffic conflict ahead. Request radar vectors for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们前方可能有冲突飞机，请求雷达引导避让。

cards.audioText: Request right turn for traffic avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求右转避让冲突飞机。

cards.audioText: Unable to comply, TCAS RA.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能照办，遵守TCASRA指令。

cards.audioText: Clear of conflict, request further instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 远离冲突，申请进一步指令。

cards.audioText: We have injuries resulting from our TCAS maneuver. Request ambulance on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: TCAS机动导致部分旅客受伤。请求救护车到场。

cards.audioText: Some passengers were injured because their seatbelts weren’t fastened.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些旅客受伤是因为他们没有系安全带。

cards.audioText: Some passengers have been scalded by hot drinks.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些旅客被热饮料烫伤了。

cards.audioText: We overran the runway end. We are evacuating. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们冲出了跑道头。我们正在撤离。请求紧急服务。

cards.audioText: We will reach our minimum fuel if we are delayed any further.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果我们进一步延误，我们将达到最低燃油量。

cards.audioText: We are declaring fuel emergency. Request priority landing Runway 03R.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们宣布燃油紧急状况。申请优先着陆，跑道03右。

cards.audioText: The military aircraft is commanding us to land at the airfield below.
cards.audioTextZh: 军用飞机正在指示我们在下面的机场着陆。

cards.audioText: We are being escorted towards the national boundary by two military aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在被两架军用机押送到国境线。

cards.audioText: A crew member is incapacitated. Request diversion and medical assistance.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名机组成员失能。请求备降和医疗救助。

cards.audioText: Confirm we have enough separation from preceding aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh: 证实我们与前机有足够间隔。

cards.audioText: Unable to expedite climb due performance.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于性能，不能加速爬升。

cards.audioText: Negative contact due visibility.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于能见度，不能看见（那一架飞机）。

cards.audioText: Unable, we are in IMC.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能，我们在仪表天气条件。

cards.audioText: Unable, we are only authorized during daytime VMC.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能，我们只有白天目视气象条件的资格。

cards.audioText: Unable noise abatement due company policy.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于公司政策，不能执行降噪音程序。

cards.audioText: Did the previous controller tell you about our problem during radar handoff?
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达移交时前面的管制员告诉你我们的问题了吗？

cards.audioText: Is there a frequency change at this compulsory reporting point?
cards.audioTextZh: 在此强制性报告点需要换频率吗？

cards.audioText: Request runway change for departure due high crosswind.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于较大侧风，请求换起飞跑道。

cards.audioText: Request delay the approach due tail wind beyond limits.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于顺风超限，请求延迟进近。

cards.audioText: Request holding instructions due weather near the runway threshold.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于跑道入口处附近的天气，请求等待指令。

cards.audioText: We had to overshoot because of wake turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不得不复飞的原因是尾流。

cards.audioText: Unable CAT II approach due crew qualification.
cards.audioTextZh: 不能Ⅱ类进近的原因是机组资质。

cards.audioText: Transmission blocked, say again.
cards.audioTextZh: 被干扰了，再说一遍。

cards.audioText: Standby, high pilot workload.
cards.audioTextZh: 稍等，飞行员工作负荷较大。

cards.audioText: We had to go around due to unstable approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们必须复飞是因为进近不稳定。

cards.audioText: Right heading 330, descending to 3000 feet, cleared for ILS approach Runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 右转航向330，下降到3000英尺，可以盲降进近，跑道36右。

cards.audioText: Cleared to exit the hold, fly direct to ML. Contact Approach on 128.35.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以离开等待，直飞ML。联系进近128.35，

cards.audioText: After passing SY VOR, leave the hold on heading 250, cleared for VOR approach Runway 06.
cards.audioTextZh: 过SYVOR台后，离开等待，航向250，可以VOR进近，跑道06号。

cards.audioText: Cleared to LHR, hold at LHR as published. Maintain 8000 feet.Expect further clearance at 18.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以飞往LHR，并按公布的航图在LHR等待。保持高度8000英尺，预计进一步许可时间18。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination via ZAM, flight planned route, D03 Departure,cruising level 230, squawk 3763.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由ZAM飞往目的地，按照计划航路，D-03号标准仪表离场，巡航高度层230，应答机3763。

cards.audioText: Recleared to destination via ZF01 Departure, Runway 36R, rest of clearance unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 重新允许经由ZF-01号标准离场程序飞往目的地，跑道36R，其余许可不变。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination, BK02 RNAV Departure, initially 3000 feet,departure frequency 125.4, squawk 3311.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以到目的地机场，BK02号RNAV离场，起始高度3000英尺，离场频率125.4，应答机编码3311。

cards.audioText: Behind Boeing747 passing left to right, taxi to holding point A1 Runway 24.
cards.audioTextZh: 后面的波音747从左向右通过后，滑行至24号跑道等待点A1。

cards.audioText: Thicker patches of fog exist further along the runway. RVR significantly reduced.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道后端雾会变浓。跑道视程明显变差。

cards.audioText: Your radar vector appears to be taking us to the prohibited area,confirm.
cards.audioTextZh: 雷达引导好像把我们带入了禁飞区，证实。

cards.audioText: We have traffic at our 12 o’clock, 5 miles, 500 feet below, climbing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们看到了活动飞机，在12点钟方位，5海里，低于我们500英尺，正在上升。

cards.audioText: We are too low to the surrounding terrain. Confirm we are still being radar vectored.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们高度太低，周围有地形。证实我们仍然被雷达引导。

cards.audioText: Hold over BKM VOR at FL100, inbound track 280 degrees, left hand pattern, outbound time 1 minute.
cards.audioTextZh: 在BKMVOR台等待，高度层100，向台航迹280度，左等待，背台时间1分钟。

cards.audioText: Reduce to minimum approach speed, turn right heading 230,cleared for ILS approach Runway 27.
cards.audioTextZh: 减小到最小进近速度，右转航向230，可以盲降进近，跑道27号。

cards.audioText: Climb to and maintain FL310. Maintain Mach number decimal 81 or greater until BKM VOR.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升并保持高度310。BKMVOR台前保持马赫数点81或更大。

cards.audioText: Descend to and maintain FL 270. Do not exceed Mach number decimal 79.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降并保持高度270。不要超出马赫数点79。

cards.audioText: Climb to and maintain FL290, re-cleared to track direct to BKM VOR, the rest unchanged.
cards.audioTextZh: 上升并保持高度290，重新直飞BKMVOR台，其余未变。

cards.audioText: Passing POU at 43, maintaining FL310, estimating MLT at 55,next NLD.
cards.audioTextZh: 当前位置POU，时间43分，高度310，预计MLT55分，下一位置NLD。

cards.audioText: Request clearance to enter controlled airspace northeast of BKM VOR at FL240 at time 43.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求在BKMVOR台东北方向高度240，时间43分时进入管制空域的许可。

cards.audioText: Descending to FL60, maintain VMC FL90 to FL70, report traffic in sight at FL80.
cards.audioTextZh: 下降到高度层60，高度90到高度70之间保持目视气象条件，高度80看见活动飞机报告。

cards.audioText: Cleared to destination airport via DAPRO, flight planned route,FL240, join A1 at FL240.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以按DAPRO计划航路飞往目的地机场，高度240，并在高度层240加入A1航路。

cards.audioText: Cleared to leave A1 via BKM VOR, maintain FL230 while in controlled airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 可以经由BKMVOR台离开A1，在管制空域保持高度230。

cards.audioText: At 150W(west) contact San Francisco Radio, primary 3494,secondary 11342.
cards.audioTextZh: 在西经150度联系旧金山无线电，主高频3494，备份高频11342。

cards.audioText: All our air conditioning packs have malfunctioned. Request rapid descent to MEA .
cards.audioTextZh: 我们全部的空调组件已故障。请求快速下降到最低航路高度。

cards.audioText: We had a malfunction of one air conditioning pack. Request descent to a lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个空调组件故障。请求下降到较低高度。

cards.audioText: We have lost electrical power to the cabin air compressor. Request immediate descent to 10,000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的客舱空气压缩机失去电源。请求立即下降到10000英尺。

cards.audioText: We have unusual smell from air conditioning packs. Request stop climb at 7000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 空调组件出现异常气味。请求在7000英尺，停止爬升。

cards.audioText: Request descent rate less than 500 feet per minute due to unpressurized cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于客舱失压，请求下降率小于每分钟500英尺。

cards.audioText: We have an avionics ventilation problem. The skin heat-exchangers and blower fan have failed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的电子通风有问题。蒙皮热交换器和吹风扇都故障了。

cards.audioText: We have a navigation map shift, unable to perform the RNAV approach. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有导航地图漂移，无法飞RNAV进近。申请雷达引导。

cards.audioText: Inertial reference system has failed. We are navigating on raw data. Request conventional approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 惯导失效了，我们正在使用原始导航，申请传统进近。

cards.audioText: The ILS signal seems to be very unstable. Did any other pilot report a similar situation?
cards.audioTextZh: 盲降信号不稳定，其他飞行员报告过类似情况吗？

cards.audioText: The ILS signal was unstable. Request approach to another runway or request another type of approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 盲降信号不稳定。申请换一条跑道进近，或申请另一种进近方式。

cards.audioText: The DME indication is not correct. Confirm the DME is still in service.
cards.audioTextZh: DME显示不对。证实DME还在运行中。

cards.audioText: We need a few minutes to reprogram the flight management computers. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要几分钟重新输程序到飞行管理计算机，申请雷达引导。

cards.audioText: We need to reconfigure the flight management computers for approach. Request holding instructions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要重新设置飞行管理计算机，申请等待指令。

cards.audioText: We are now flying with basic navigation due to systems failure. Request radar vectors.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于系统故障，我们现在使用基本导航飞行。申请雷达引导。

cards.audioText: We are not qualified for CAT IIIB approach and auto-land. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不具备IIIB类进近和自动着陆资格。请求改航。

cards.audioText: Our VHF number One receiver has failed. We are no longer monitoring 121.5.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们第一部甚高频接收机失效，我们不再监听121.5。

cards.audioText: All of our VHF transmitters have failed, now transmitting on HF radio. Please respond.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们所有甚高频发射机都失效了，现在高频无线电发报，请回复。

cards.audioText: One of our transformers has failed. I’ll let you know if a diversion is required.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们一个变压整流器故障了。如果需要备降我会第一时间告诉你。

cards.audioText: We are operating with only the emergency generator. Request track direct to final, Runway 26.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们能够使用的只有紧急发电机。申请直飞五边，跑道26号。

cards.audioText: We are flying with batteries only. Is there any airport available within 25 minutes of flying?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仅依靠电瓶飞行。有没有25分钟之内能够飞到的可用机场？

cards.audioText: If there is no airport within 100 miles, we have to make a forced landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 如果100海里范围内没有机场，我们必须迫降。

cards.audioText: We have cut off the electrical system to the cabin and the onboard fire is under control.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经切断了到客舱的电气系统，机上火情得到了控制。

cards.audioText: We had an electrical fire from the galley, now extinguished. Request return to land.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有厨房电气火警，现在已经熄灭。请求返场着陆。

cards.audioText: There was a fire from the avionics bay. Request radar vectors for final.
cards.audioTextZh: 电子设备舱有火警。请求雷达引导到五边。

cards.audioText: We cannot extinguish the engine fire. Request priority landing and emergency services on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能熄灭发动机火情。申请优先落地和到场时的紧急服务。

cards.audioText: A passenger ignited the lavatory waste bin. Advise the airport police to await our arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 一名旅客点燃了盥洗室垃圾桶。告知机场警察到场来处理。

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are evacuating. Request fire trucks.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱。我们正在紧急撤离。申请消防车。

cards.audioText: We have smoke coming from our avionics bay. We are disembarking the passengers.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自我们的电子设备舱，我们正在让旅客离机。

cards.audioText: We have emptied most of our fire extinguishers, but the cabin fire is still on.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已经释放了灭火瓶，但客舱火警仍然存在。

cards.audioText: Our flight control computers are not functioning well. We are having difficulty maintaining level flight, unable RVSM.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们飞行操作计算机工作不太理想，我们保持平飞有些困难，不能在RVSM空域飞行。

cards.audioText: The aircraft has a tendency to roll to the right. I need additional airspace to maneuver.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞机有向右横滚的趋势，我需要更多的的空域来机动。

cards.audioText: Request high speed approach. Part of our flight control surfaces have separated from the wing.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求大速度进近。部分飞机操作面与机翼分离。

cards.audioText: Request vectors for long final. We are controlling the airplane with mechanical backup.
cards.audioTextZh: 请求雷达引导到长五边。我们正用机械备用设备操作飞机。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with yaw damping. The aircraft is oscillating severely. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们偏航阻尼出现问题，飞机摇摆很严重，申请备降。

cards.audioText: We have a problem with fuel temperature. Request holding position on the taxiway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的燃油温度有问题。请求滑行道上原地等待。

cards.audioText: We might have a fuel leak near the wing root. Request fire trucks on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 翼根可能存在漏油，申请消防车到场。

cards.audioText: We are evacuating. Advise emergency personnel that fuel odors are still present in the cabin.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们正在紧急撤离。请告诉地面人员机上仍然有燃油味道。

cards.audioText: We are too heavy for landing. Request fuel-dump at the fuel dumping area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们返场落地重量会太重。申请去放油区域放油。

cards.audioText: We need about 18 minutes to jettison fuel before coming in for the approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在进近前需要大概18分钟放油。

cards.audioText: We cannot shut off the fuel dump valve. Request radar vectors for short final, Runway 17.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们无法关断放油活门，申请雷达引导到短五边，跑道17。

cards.audioText: We are indicating fuel filter clog. Request descent and to maintain high speed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示有燃油过滤阻塞，申请下降并保持大速度。

cards.audioText: We are near the freezing temperature of jet fuel. Request descent to FL 390.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们接近燃油的冰点温度，申请下降到高度390。

cards.audioText: Request the longest runway and vectors for a wide downwind due to hydraulic failure.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于液压失效，请求最长的跑道和雷达引导到宽的三边。

cards.audioText: We still have only one hydraulic system. Request the longest runway for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们仍然有一套液压系统。申请最长的跑道着陆。

cards.audioText: Our left engine anti-ice system has failed. Request immediate climb to leave the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的左发防冰系统故障，申请立即上升来脱离结冰区域。

cards.audioText: We must descend immediately to exit icing conditions. Our right engine bleed air has failed.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们必须立即下降脱离结冰条件。我们的右发引气已失效。

cards.audioText: Our pitot static heating system has failed. We might have an altitude error.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们皮托管静压口加温系统故障了，我们可能有高度误差。

cards.audioText: We have an error in our airspeed. Request to climb to minimum safe altitude.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速有误差。申请上升到最低安全高度以上。

cards.audioText: We have master warning lights in the cockpit. Request landing at the nearest suitable airport.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的驾驶舱主警告灯亮了。申请就近合适机场着陆。

cards.audioText: We have a master caution. I will notify you if a diversion is required.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个主警告灯亮了。如需备降，我将告知。

cards.audioText: Some of our instruments are not indicating correctly. Request level off to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 一些仪表不能正确显示，申请改平飞执行检查单。

cards.audioText: Two of our display units have failed. We are no longer RNP qualified. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的两个显示屏故障。我们不再具备RNP资格。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We made the go around due to map drift on our navigation display.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞是因为导航显示上地图漂移。

cards.audioText: We have autopilot disconnection. We are no longer RVSM qualified. Request leaving RVSM airspace.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们自动驾驶脱开了，我们不再符合RVSM资质，申请离开RVSM空域。

cards.audioText: Request to climb to minimum safe altitude due to malfunction of navigation computers.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于导航计算机故障，申请爬升到最低安全高度。

cards.audioText: We have conflicting traffic at one o’clock, 6 miles, descending. Request heading 130 for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们1点钟方位，6海里处，正在下降。申请航向130来避开。

cards.audioText: We have conflicting traffic at eleven o’clock, 8 miles, climbing. Request vectors for avoidance.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示冲突飞机在我们11点钟方位，8海里处，正在上升。申请雷达引导来避开。

cards.audioText: Traffic at our twelve o’clock, 10 miles, climbing. Should we expedite our descent to cross altitudes?
cards.audioTextZh: 冲突飞机在我们12点钟方位，10海里处，正在上升。我们应该加速下降穿越高度吗？

cards.audioText: We are having abnormal engine indications. Request to reduce speed to 250 knots.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们显示不正常的发动机参数。申请调速到250节。

cards.audioText: Our oil pressure reading is lower than normal. Request hold at present position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们滑油压力读数比正常要低。请求在当前位置等待。

cards.audioText: The oil temperature is higher than normal. We are monitoring other engine parameters.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们滑油温度比正常的要高。我们正在监控其他发动机参数。

cards.audioText: We are holding at present position. It appears one of the over-wing exits has unlocked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们在原地等待。好像机翼上方的一个出口松锁。

cards.audioText: Our brakes have seized. The tyres might burst during touchdown. Request fire trucks on arrival.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的刹车卡死了。可能接地时轮胎会爆胎。申请消防车到场。

cards.audioText: We have exhausted all options. We will land without the nose gear fully locked.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们用尽了所有选项。现在只能够尝试没有前起落架完全锁住的情况下落地。

cards.audioText: The tyres are deflated. We will have to hold at present position for maintenance inspection.
cards.audioTextZh: 轮胎瘪了，我们需要原地等待机务来做检查。

cards.audioText: Our inertial reference system has failed, unable GPS approach. Request ILS or VOR approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的惯导失效了，不能够使用GPS进近。申请盲降或VOR进近。

cards.audioText: We have to recalibrate our instruments. Request to level off and maintain heading.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们需要重新校准仪表。申请改平飞并保持航向。

cards.audioText: Our airspeed is unreliable. Request climb to minimum safe altitude to perform checklist.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速指示不可靠。申请爬升到最低安全高度来做检查单。

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has failed and we are in IMC. Request return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达失效，我们仪表气象条件飞行。申请返场落地。

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has malfunctioned. What is the highest available level for cruise?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达故障。最高可用的巡航高度是多少？

cards.audioText: Our weather radar has failed. How did the preceding aircraft deviate from the weather?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们气象雷达坏了。前机都怎么绕飞的？

cards.audioText: We do not have that route in our database. Which heading should we maintain for now？
cards.audioTextZh: 我们数据库没有这个航路。我们现在应该保持哪个航向？

cards.audioText: We have a navigation malfunction. Request diversion to a suitable airport that has less complex terrain.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有导航故障。申请备降到就近的较少复杂地形的机场。

cards.audioText: Our APU bleed air malfunctioned during engine startup. We are calling the ground staff, standby.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的APU引气在发动机开车时故障了。我们正在呼叫地面机务，请稍等。

cards.audioText: We are leaking bleed air. Request turn right heading 095 to avoid the icing area.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的引气正在泄漏。请求右转095以避开结冰区。

cards.audioText: We have an abnormal noise coming from one of our cabin doors. Request rapid descent to 5000 feet.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有一个客舱门有异常噪音。申请快速下降到5000英尺。

cards.audioText: Smoke is coming from the cabin floor. We are performing an evacuation. All slides have been deployed.
cards.audioTextZh: 有烟雾来自客舱地板。我们正在进行撤离。滑梯已经放出。

cards.audioText: We had a smoke warning from the forward cargo hold. We are evacuating.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有烟雾来自前货舱。我们正在进行撤离。

cards.audioText: We have a cargo smoke warning. We are disembarking passengers. Request fire services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们有货舱烟雾警告。我们正在让旅客下飞机。请求消防服务。

cards.audioText: The cockpit windshield has cracked. Request descent to FL220.
cards.audioTextZh: 驾驶舱风挡裂了。请求下降高度220。

cards.audioText: Neither of us can see through our windshield. Does your airport permit auto-land?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们和副驾驶都无法通过风挡看到外面。你机场允许自动着陆吗？

cards.audioText: Our engine control has malfunctioned. We cannot get much thrust. Request immediate descent.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的发动机控制有故障。我们不能得到较大推力。申请立即下降。

cards.audioText: We have a low oil pressure warning from engine Number Two. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的二发有滑油压力低的警告。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We have performed our procedures but engine vibration still exists. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已完成了程序但发动机抖振仍然存在。申请备降。

cards.audioText: Engine Number Three has smoke coming out of the pylon section. We are evacuating.
cards.audioTextZh: 三号发动机吊架部位出现烟雾。我们正在撤离。

cards.audioText: Our left engine has ingested FOD. We are shutting down engines and holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的左发吸入了外物而损坏。我们马上关车并原地等待。

cards.audioText: We made a diversion due to reports of freezing rain at our original destination.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们备降是由于收到目的地机场冻雨报告。

cards.audioText: We are encountering clear ice. Request immediate right turn to heading 130.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们遇到了明冰。申请立即右转航向130。

cards.audioText: We cannot continue holding in icing conditions. Request descent immediately and cancel speed restrictions.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们不能在结冰条件下继续等待。请求立即下降并取消速度限制。

cards.audioText: We have a “Wind-shear Ahead” warning message. Request to delay takeoff or change to another runway.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们出现了“前方风切变”警告信息。请求延迟起飞，或换一条跑道。

cards.audioText: We have received information of a new volcanic eruption. Will it affect our route?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们收到火山喷发的一条新信息，会影响我们航路吗？

cards.audioText: We are unsure of our position due heavy fog. We are holding position.
cards.audioTextZh: 由于浓雾，我们不确定我们的位置。原地等待中。

cards.audioText: We had a rapid airspeed decay due turbulence. Request immediate descent to FL390.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们的空速由于颠簸快速衰减。申请立即下降到高度390。

cards.audioText: I apologize for the level bust, but we needed the altitude loss to recover from wind-shear.
cards.audioTextZh: 很抱歉偏离指定高度了，但我们需要损失高度来改出风切变。

cards.audioText: The thunderstorms will last for about 40 minutes according to the weather update. Request diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 根据天气更新情况，雷暴将持续约40分钟。申请备降。

cards.audioText: We made the go-around because strong convective currents on short final made our approach unstable.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们复飞的原因是因为短五边很强的对流气流使进近不稳定。

cards.audioText: We were struck by hail. Our airframe is severely damaged. Request emergency services.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们被冰雹击中了。我们的机身严重受损。申请紧急服务。

cards.audioText: Request to cancel our approach. The runway is not long enough and there are water patches.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请取消进近。跑道不够长，还有部分积水。

cards.audioText: Request holding instructions. We’ll attempt another approach when the rain showers become lighter.
cards.audioTextZh: 申请等待指令。阵雨变小的时候我们再重新进近。

cards.audioText: We have observed blowing sand in the vicinity of the airport. How long will this last?
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已观察到在机场邻近地区有吹沙，持续多长时间呢？

cards.audioText: Runway is covered with patches of ice. Braking action is medium to poor.
cards.audioTextZh: 跑道被大片结冰覆盖。刹车效应中等偏差。

cards.audioText: A Pilot overflying reported seeing virga above the runways. Request to terminate our approach.
cards.audioTextZh: 飞越的一名飞行员报告在跑道上空看见了雨幡。申请终止进近。

cards.audioText: Lining up Runway 35. Runway lights are too bright. Request to dim the runway lights.
cards.audioTextZh: 进跑道35。跑道灯太亮。申请调暗跑道灯。

cards.audioText: The NOTAM says this part of the taxiway is closed during this period, please verify.
cards.audioTextZh: 航行通告说部分滑行道在这期间关闭。请核实。

cards.audioText: We are stopping taxi. The boarding bridge is not at its designated position.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们停止（滑行）了。廊桥不在指定位置。

cards.audioText: Our cabin crew will direct all passengers to stay outside the runway after evacuation.
cards.audioTextZh: 撤离后我们的客舱机组将指导所有旅客待在跑道外。

cards.audioText: We have had a tail strike. Request to stop climb at 3000 feet and return for landing.
cards.audioTextZh: 我们已发生机尾擦地。请求3000英尺停止爬升并返场着陆。

cards.audioText: We have veered off the runway due asymmetric thrust. We are evacuating. Request emergency assistance.
